title: icon bar: settings per view and in general, SHIFT+drag zoom, tooltips scaled, new icons for lines/edges/faces, model interval in the update list
author: Claude-JG
description: SHIFT + left mouse drag zooms to a region (CTRL+A stays); the tooltip left of the bar without overlap, its background up by about 15 % and 10 % higher, in the font size at the monitor scaling and general.displayScaleFactor; interactive.iconBar.show becomes view.window.showIconBar, scaling and foldDistance become general.iconBarScaling and general.iconBarFoldDistance, new general.iconBarTimeout in milliseconds (no deprecation, introduced in this version); icons: edges a rectangle meshed into 8 triangles, faces a cube with front, top and side faces, lines the edges of that cube; the update interval icon cycles through the key intervals with the interval of the model sorted in.
releaseNotes: The icon bar is switched by visualizationSettings.view0.window.showIconBar (per view) and adjusted by general.iconBarScaling, general.iconBarFoldDistance and general.iconBarTimeout (milliseconds; replaces interactive.iconBar); SHIFT + dragging with the left mouse button zooms to the rectangle dragged; the tooltips no longer overlap the bar and follow the display scaling and displayScaleFactor; new icons for lines, edges and faces; the update interval icon includes the interval set by the model (revision2026c step RG6.19.4)
